method: Whole-file manual reading of UiControls.h; pinned bytes verified. No native controls executed.
findings: CEdit GetSel uses packed EM_GETSEL return and extracts16bit endpoints, unlike full-width out-parameter form. Selections beyond65535characters are not represented by this wrapper; no actual user field counterexample tested.

Combo GetItemText queries length, allocates length+1 and copies via native message, mapping CB_ERR to empty result. It assumes control contents remain consistent across synchronous query/copy; no concurrent/reentrant mutation test.

RichEdit text-range wrapper computes signed cpMax-cpMin before clamping and allocation; arbitrary extreme range arithmetic is not guarded. Normal ENLINK ranges from About dialog were source-reviewed, not runtime qualified.

List row geometry cache covers at most16logical columns per draw dispatch, uses header rectangles mapped into list coordinates to respect reorder/scroll, and falls back to native query outside cached range or failed entry. No pixel/performance parity measurement.

SetRowHeight creates and immediately detaches/destroys a temporary image list; it does not preserve a preexisting small-image-list attachment. Actual callers and icon ownership require runtime qualification.

Tooltip wrappers pass caller text pointers rather than owning strings; native API consumption/lifetime expectations must be satisfied by caller. Recovery dialog persistent tooltip array is one reviewed caller, not general lifetime proof.

BufferedDC allocates full client bitmap, selects/restores it and blits in destructor only after successful selection. On allocation/selection failure it does not redirect drawing to target, and destructor ignores blit failure.

ScopedRedrawPause always reenables redraw on destruction rather than restoring prior state or nesting count. Nested pauses therefore need caller coordination. Wait cursor uses scoped thread-local active flag and restores prior cursor.
limits: No Windows edit selection, list geometry, image list, tooltip lifetime, redraw nesting, allocation failure or buffered paint tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
